'''Hangar 2-7''' was a [[hangar]] located in the Imperial Complex on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Family" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the Liberation of Lothal to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Spectres]] rebel cell captured [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] and took control of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] "dome".

When the Spectres attempted to execute [[Protocol 13]], an [[Imperial officer|officer]] asked "Command" if the protocol was really going into effect, after former [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] announced the protocol to the Imperial troops, [[Ryder Azadi]] impersonated [[Colonel]] [[Wullf Yularen]], trying to make the officer execute the protocol, although the rebels doubted he would execute it, the officer executed the protocol just after Azadi asked him if he always questioned a superior officer's orders.<ref name="Family" />
